Optimization Tips
Headlines
About Section
Weekly Plan
HEADLINE
HIGH
Strengthen your headline

Your headline is the first thing recruiters see. Include your role, specialty, and value proposition.

Example: "Senior Frontend Engineer | React & TypeScript | Scaling products from 0 to 1M users"

ABOUT
HIGH
Write a compelling About section

Use the About section to tell your story. 3-5 short paragraphs work best.

Start with your current role, then highlight 2-3 key achievements, and end with what you're looking for.

SKILLS
MEDIUM
Add more skills

Profiles with 5+ relevant skills get up to 17x more profile views.

Add at least 10 skills, prioritizing those in your target job descriptions.

NETWORKING
MEDIUM
Grow your network strategically

Connect with people in your target industry, not just colleagues.

Send 5 personalized connection requests per week to hiring managers or senior engineers.

CONTENT
LOW
Post weekly content

Active posters are 9x more likely to be contacted by recruiters.

Share one thing you learned, built, or observed each week.
